invariant.ConceptUrisAreUniqueWithinOnto.review: Independent map model checks unique qualified URI after generated adds/updates/imports/retries/rejections. Equal URI across graphs/tenants is allowed; established canonical identities cannot collapse.

invariant.RelationshipEdgesAreUnique.review: Manual duplicates reject; imported forward/reverse duplicate statements yield exactly two distinct logical views. Generated parent updates check inverse sets after every operation.

invariant.ResolutionScoresAreBounded.review: Nonempty exact and semantic match evidence is checked finite in [0,1], including huge/tiny vectors. Negative, excessive, nonnumeric and nonfinite thresholds reject atomically.

invariant.TenantQualifiedRelationships.review: Cross-tenant endpoints reject. Allowed same-tenant cross-graph endpoints retain qualification through replay. Imports cannot silently retarget explicitly qualified foreign endpoints.

invariant.SourceVersionsAreScoped.review: Source read maps contain UUID source-id, content-hash and registered-at. Ontology/tenant qualification is supplied to get-sources. Same source/hash is one version; new hash remains separately queryable.

surface-actor.OntologyGraph.review: Library surface is callable functions, not a UI with hidden controls. Actor restriction is tenant context. Rule guards reject unavailable operations. Queries expose entities via qualified maps, edge views and contribution metadata.

surface-provides.OntologyGraph.review: Library surface is callable functions, not a UI with hidden controls. Actor restriction is tenant context. Rule guards reject unavailable operations. Queries expose entities via qualified maps, edge views and contribution metadata.

surface-exposure.OntologyGraph.review: Library surface is callable functions, not a UI with hidden controls. Actor restriction is tenant context. Rule guards reject unavailable operations. Queries expose entities via qualified maps, edge views and contribution metadata.

prose.AtomicValidatedMutation.review: Validation, retry, stale revision and actual storage failure leave graph/history unchanged; SQLite compare-and-append gives one winner for competing writes.

prose.HierarchyConsistency.review: Manual and imported hierarchy changes share validation; generated model checks inverse parent/child sets and rejects reachable cycles at each step.

prose.QualifiedIdentityRequired.review: URI lookup requires graph and tenant; explicit tenant-wide administrative enumeration is a separate API. No global URI identity API exists.

prose.SearchValidityAndDeterminism.review: Tests exercise each ranking signal, graph depths, weights, ties, case, limits, dimensions, model identity and numerical validity.

prose.ScopedSearchAndExport.review: Qualified reads/search plus all generated historical snapshots and fresh-store/process replay preserve graph/provenance without optional model services.

prose.ContributionIdentity.review: Scoped retry, changed payload, new interpretations of same bytes, later writes, durable reopen and additive upserts are exercised separately.

prose.DeterministicResolutionAndMerge.review: Exact/semantic type compatibility, canonical identity retention, reference rewriting, permutation, bounded scores and timestamp retention are checked against observable graph/provenance.

prose.DeterministicRdfImport.review: Supported N-Triples are parsed without a model; malformed syntax/Unicode, unsupported nodes and raw triples reject atomically. Schema/instance/literal round trips retain statements.

prose.OpaqueProducerProvenance.review: Original input and opaque producer evidence remain independent of canonical graph rewriting; no producer execution system is loaded.

prose.TenantBoundary.review: Authorization and deduplication use tenant context; equal URIs/source hashes/keys in separate tenants do not share graph state.

prose.GraphOnly.review: Tests run with standalone deps and real Grain store, without ORC/model workflow/provider; loaded namespaces are checked for orchestration components.
